sites.source: MN DNR facility cmp00037 (camping: drive_in_campsites 6, walk_in_campsites 3, group_campsites 1), read 2026-11-11

hookups.source: MN DNR facility cmp00037 ('The campsites are considered "primitive," designed to furnish only the basic needs of the camper. The campsites consist of a cleared area, fire ring, and table'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Individual sites are first come; the fee is paid online on the day of arrival (or at a state park ranger station) before taking a site. The group site ($50) is reserved through ReserveMN up to 120 days ahead.

booking.source: MN DNR facility cmp00037 ('All campsites require a fee that must be paid before occupying a campsite. Same-day advance payments are available for individual and equestrian campsites'; 'Reservations for group campsites can be made up to 120 days in advance') + https://www.dnr.state.mn.us/state-forests/fees-reservations.html ('Group campsites $50'; Gulch Lake listed among campgrounds with group campsites), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Minnesota state forest individual campsite, taxes included ($22 applies only to equestrian sites, none here). Paid online on the arrival date or at a state park ranger station; nothing is collected at the campground. DNR state forest fee page, read 2026-11-11.

fees.source: https://www.dnr.state.mn.us/state-forests/fees-reservations.html ('Individual and equestrian campsites $17 - $22'; 'Starting in 2026 ... $17 per night ($22 for equestrian)'; 'Fees include taxes'; 'DNR does not accept self-payment envelopes on site') + DNR facility cmp00037 (fee 1; no equestrian sites), read 2026-11-11

note: Rustic DNR state-forest campground beside the public landing between Lake Twenty-One and Bass Lake, with Nelson Lake just south, in the Paul Bunyan Game Refuge: a non-motorized area where ATVs are not allowed. Six drive-in sites; three walk-in sites and a group site are separate. Access to the North Country National Scenic Trail, hiking trails and picnic sites. Managed by Itasca State Park. --Claude
summary: DNR facility cmp00037 read: 6 drive-in + 3 walk-in + 1 group site, primitive, vault toilets, well water; $17 tax-included same-day pay (high 22 -> 17: equestrian rate not here); group site reservable. Sites 9 -> 6 (drive-in only). Not waterfront kept. Managing park is Itasca SP, not Lake Bemidji; phone and website fixes.
